I retried with the picker item ref, with a[data-scope][data-value="1"], and with the inner span.ui.label chip; transiently the item gained a "checked" class, but after a full page reload to /bench/bench-repo/issues/4 all four picker items were back to class "item muted" with no visible check marks, confirming nothing was persisted. No label was applied, so the sidebar shows no labels at all. The issue itself is intact and unmodified otherwise: #4, title "fwgt27-n1 Bench Issue", description rendered as "Bench issue created for run fwgt27-n1.".
